reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: forceToggleAttendance is exported and called by UsersTab.tsx:179 (non-test). Gate 2: entry point is a direct HTTP POST from any authenticated user (untrusted; no trust_assumptions defined). Gate 3: src/app/actions.ts is explicitly in-scope. Code confirms zero auth guard in the function body (no getUser(), no is_admin check); it immediately calls createSupabaseAdminClient() (service_role, full RLS bypass). An attacker can trigger this via direct HTTP POST to the Server Action endpoint by extracting the Server Action ID from the compiled client bundle and supplying an arbitrary victim userId, causing forged attendance records (clock-in/out) to be inserted for any member while fully bypassing RLS and admin-only access controls. The admin layout guard at src/app/admin/layout.tsx:17-21 only executes on page-render (GET) and provides no protection for Server Action invocations (POST). Severity remains HIGH: authorization bypass affecting all members' attendance integrity, attacker only needs a valid session.
